info.title: Oyster Object Storage API
info.description: A content-addressed object storage API with buckets, blobs, and API key authentication.

put.summary: Update billing information for the authenticated account. Not yet implemented.

post.summary: Request an immediate storage-pool extension retry.
post.description:
Call this after funding the account's wallet (see `/account/wallet` or
the `account.funding_required` webhook): it clears the extension
worker's retry backoff so the pool is re-attempted on the next worker
cycle instead of waiting out the exponential backoff. Issues no chain
transactions itself — the background worker performs the extension.

put.description:
Logic:
1. If the account has no on-chain `StoragePool` yet, just update the DB
   cap — no on-chain action is needed because future uploads enforce the
   new cap before any lazy-create.
2. Otherwise read the on-chain pool's
   `reserved_encoded_capacity_bytes` / `used_encoded_bytes` and compute
   `threshold = f(new_cap)` (same `f` as the upload-side cap check).
3. If `used_encoded > threshold`, reject 400 — lowering the cap would
   orphan currently-stored data.
4. If `reserved_encoded > threshold`, submit a Pearl-signed
   `decrease_storage_pool_capacity_by_size` PTB. The contract's own
   assertion guarantees the chain refuses to cut into `used_encoded`,
   so a concurrent race surfaces as a structured 400 with the chain's
   MoveAbort context.
5. Persist the new cap and reconcile DB pool counters to the
   post-shrink on-chain truth only when the shrink succeeded (or none
   was needed).

200.description: Cap updated; response carries the post-update on-chain pool snapshot and the shrink tx digest when a shrink was submitted

400.description: Invalid request, would orphan data, or shrink aborted

503.description: On-chain shrink unavailable in this configuration

get.summary:
Return the authenticated app, including its current webhook URL and
public key. Useful when an admin lost the response from `set_webhook_url`.

200.description: The authenticated app, including the webhook public key

put.summary:
Register or rotate the webhook URL for the authenticated app. Each call
generates a fresh Ed25519 keypair; the returned public key is the only
way to verify subsequent webhook deliveries.

200.description: Webhook URL set; response includes the freshly-generated public key

delete.summary:
Clear the webhook URL and discard the keypair for the authenticated app.
Subsequent extension failures will not deliver a webhook.

get.summary: Read a blob's content by its content-addressed blob ID. No authentication required.
List all buckets owned by the authenticated account, with cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

post.summary: Create a new bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique.

delete.summary: Delete an empty bucket. Returns 409 Conflict if the bucket still contains blobs.

get.summary: List all blobs in a bucket, with cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

get.summary: Read a blob's content by bucket name and key. No authentication required.

put.summary: Upload a blob into a bucket at the given key. The request body is the raw binary content. Uploading to the same key overwrites.

400.description: Upload would push the account past its per-account `max_unencoded_bytes` cap. Body carries a `cap_exceeded` block; the admin can raise the cap via `PUT /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/max-storage`.

402.description: Insufficient on-chain balance to fund the upload. Body carries a `funding_required` block hinting at how much WAL (FROST) and SUI (MIST) the Pearl-derived wallet needs.

409.description: Bucket was deleted concurrently while the upload was in flight. The on-chain `PooledBlob` is best-effort compensated before this response is returned; see `oyster_post_store_compensation_total` for the success/failure outcome.

413.description: Payload too large. Either the body exceeded the static MAX_BLOB_SIZE cap (no structured body) or the upload exceeded the Walrus encoder's per-blob ceiling for this network's n_shards (body carries a `payload_too_large` block).

delete.summary: Delete a blob by its bucket name and key. The underlying data is only removed when no other objects reference it.

402.description: Insufficient on-chain balance to clear the PooledBlob. Body carries a `funding_required` block.

get.summary: List all tags on a blob.

put.summary: Replace the entire tag set on a blob (S3 `PutObjectTagging`-equivalent).

delete.summary: Remove every tag from a blob (S3 `DeleteObjectTagging`-equivalent).

patch.summary: Merge a partial tag set into a blob's existing tags (upsert per key).

put.summary: Upsert a single tag on a blob (body is the raw value).

delete.summary: Delete a single tag from a blob. Idempotent.

AccountId.description: A strongly-typed Oyster account identifier (UUID v4).

AccountSummary.description: One-row summary of an account, returned by `GET /accounts`.

active_api_key_count.description: Number of active (non-revoked) API keys on this account.

ApiKeyMetadata.description: Public API key metadata. Never includes the bearer secret.

prefix.description: First 8 characters of the raw key.

ApiKeyWithBearerToken.description: A newly created API key, including the Bearer token (shown only once).

App.description: An Oyster app — organizational trust boundary for account creation.

contact_email.description: Contact email for the app owner.

webhook_public_key.description:
Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key paired with the active webhook URL,
or `None` when no webhook is configured.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL for extension failure notifications.

AppWithPublicKey.description:
Response shape for app endpoints that return the public key alongside
the standard `App` fields.

contact_email.description: Contact email for the app owner.

webhook_public_key.description:
Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key for verifying webhook deliveries,
or `None` when no webhook is configured.

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL, or `None` when no webhook is configured.

encoded_size.description:
Walrus-encoded size in bytes, if registered on-chain. `None` for
local-store blobs and for dedup-skipped duplicate rows (the original
registering row still carries the encoded size).

key.description: User-chosen object key (like a file path).

pooled_blob_object_id.description: On-chain Sui object ID of the `PooledBlob`, if stored on Walrus.

BlobTagsResponse.description: Response body for listing a blob's tags.

tags.description: Tags for the blob. Deterministically ordered for stable responses.

Bucket.description: A named container for blobs within an account.

CapExceededDetails.description: Details accompanying a 400 from the storage-cap path.

admin_endpoint.description: Admin route that can raise the cap.

new_unencoded_bytes.description: Unencoded size of the rejected upload.

used_encoded_bytes.description: On-chain encoded usage observed at check time.

CapExceededErrorResponse.description:
Body returned with a 400 Bad Request when an upload would push the
account past its `max_unencoded_bytes` cap. Emitted by `store_blob`
(JSON) and `put_object` (S3 surface mirrors the message text). The
`cap_exceeded` block points the caller at the admin endpoint that
can raise the cap.

cap_exceeded.description: Structured details for the cap-exceeded case.

CreateAccountRequest.description: Request body for creating a new account.

avg_blob_size.description:
Optional assumed average blob size, in *unencoded* bytes, used to
turn `max_unencoded_bytes` into a *lower* bound on storable
capacity (see [`Account::avg_blob_size`]). Defaults to
`OYSTER_DEFAULT_AVG_BLOB_SIZE` (10 MB) when omitted. `0` disables
inflation; negative values are rejected with 400; an oversized
value is accepted as a silent no-op.

max_unencoded_bytes.description:
Optional per-account storage cap, in *unencoded* bytes.
Defaults to `5_000_000_000` (5 × 10⁹ bytes) when omitted. Must
be strictly positive; `0` and negative values are rejected with
400.

name.description: Human-readable account name. Defaults to the account ID if omitted.

note.description:
Optional note attached to the auto-issued initial API key.
Defaults to "api" when omitted.

CreateAccountResponse.description: Response after creating a new account.

api_key.description: The initial API key (with bearer token).

note.description:
Optional note attached to the new API key. Defaults to "api"
when omitted.

CreateBucketRequest.description: Request body for creating a new bucket.

ExtendRequestResponse.description: Response for a user-requested storage-pool extension retry.

pool_end_epoch.description:
The pool's current end epoch as tracked by Oyster; advances once
the retried extension lands.

status.description:
Always `"scheduled"`: the background extension worker will retry
on its next cycle (typically within a minute).

FundingAmount.description:
WAL/SUI top-up estimate attached to both the synchronous 402 response
body and the `account.funding_required` webhook payload.

sui_mist.description: Required SUI, in MIST units (1 SUI = 1e9 MIST).

wal_frost.description: Required WAL, in FROST units (1 WAL = 1e9 FROST).

InsufficientBalanceErrorResponse.description:
Body returned with a 402 Payment Required when the account's Pearl
wallet can't cover the requested operation. `funding_required` is
`None` when the price-lookup itself failed.

oneOf.description: Best-effort WAL/SUI top-up estimate, or `None` on lookup failure.

encoded_size.description:
Walrus-encoded size in bytes, if registered on-chain. `None` for
local-store blobs and for dedup-skipped duplicate rows (the original
registering row still carries the encoded size).

key.description: User-chosen object key (like a file path).

pooled_blob_object_id.description: On-chain Sui object ID of the `PooledBlob`, if stored on Walrus.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page, if more results exist.

items.description: A named container for blobs within an account.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page, if more results exist.

PatchTagsRequest.description: Request body for a partial tag-set merge.

tags.description: Tags to upsert onto the existing set.

PayloadTooLargeDetails.description: Details accompanying a 413 from the encoder-ceiling path.

max_unencoded_bytes_for_network.description: Per-network maximum unencoded blob size at this `n_shards`.

n_shards.description: Number of shards in the network's encoding config.

unencoded_size_bytes.description: Size of the rejected upload, in unencoded bytes.

PayloadTooLargeErrorResponse.description:
Body returned with a 413 Payload Too Large when an upload
exceeds the network's per-blob encoder ceiling. Distinct from
the static `MAX_BLOB_SIZE` body-limit 413 (which has no structured
`payload_too_large` block).

payload_too_large.description: Structured details for the encoder-ceiling case.

reserved_encoded_bytes.description: `storage.storage_size` — encoded bytes reserved by the pool.

used_encoded_bytes.description:
`used_encoded_bytes` — encoded bytes currently consumed by
registered blobs.

PutTagsRequest.description: Request body for a full tag-set replace.

webhook_url.description:
The webhook URL to register. Must be `https://`, must not embed
credentials, must have a host. Each call generates a fresh keypair.

StoreBlobResponse.description: Response after successfully storing a blob.

pooled_blob_object_id.description: On-chain Sui object ID of the `PooledBlob`, if applicable.

UpdateBlobMetadataRequest.description: Request body for updating blob metadata.

avg_blob_size.description:
Optional new assumed average blob size, in *unencoded* bytes (see
[`Account::avg_blob_size`]). When omitted, the account's existing
`avg_blob_size` is retained and the orphan/shrink threshold is
recomputed against it. `0` disables inflation; negative values
are rejected with 400; an oversized value is a silent no-op.

max_unencoded_bytes.description:
New per-account cap, in *unencoded* bytes. Must be strictly
positive; `0` and negative values are rejected with 400.

account_id.description: The account whose cap was updated.

avg_blob_size.description:
The effective assumed average blob size after the update (see
[`Account::avg_blob_size`]). Echoes the request value when
supplied, otherwise the account's retained value.

oneOf.description:
On-chain `StoragePool` snapshot after the (optional) shrink.
`None` when the account has never lazy-created a pool (so no
on-chain read was performed).

shrink_tx_digest.description:
Digest of the submitted shrink PTB, or `None` when no shrink
was needed.
